# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.4 — Repeat announcements and full configuration localization

This release includes the previously unreleased v0.2.3 improvements as well as the v0.2.4 translation audit. Existing Home Assistant integration settings, sensor entities, and Lovelace card remain intact.

## New — Repeat recommendations (v0.2.3)

- **Repeat announcements (minutes)** appears under **Configure → Announcements**. Default: **10 minutes**; set **0** to disable reminders (range 0–1440).
- A reminder repeats only while the same actionable recommendation and underlying reason persist. Timing and cancellation are tracked **per room**, so changes in one room do not restart another room's alerts.
- Readings are rechecked before each reminder; changes in numeric values above the same threshold do not unnecessarily reset the timer, but resolved recommendations or changed causes do.
- Works with Announcement Hub, native Home Assistant TTS/notifications and persistent-notification fallback.
- The initial 90-second stable-open delay and immediate urgent-close advice remain unchanged. The integration advises only; it never operates a window.

## Fixed — Home Assistant configuration translations (v0.2.4)

- **Greek Weather and warnings:** explanations beneath weather and warning selectors are translated, along with outdoor sensor, Announcements and per-room help.
- All **18 advanced threshold labels** now have native Greek, German, French and Spanish translations.
- All **38 supported languages** have translated configuration/Options help, field labels, errors and abort messages instead of inherited English fallback strings.
- Output-language choice uses Home Assistant's native selector translations for **Home Assistant default**, and the default conversation agent label is translated as well.
- A reviewed translation overlay and automated completeness tests help prevent future regressions when language JSON files are regenerated.

Dynamic provider data (weather-warning names, area and entity names, measurements) is not translated or changed. The dashboard language and announcement language continue to work independently.

## Install or update

Use **HACS → Air Quality Advisor → Update to v0.2.4**, restart Home Assistant, then open **Configure → Announcements** to set the repeat interval. Existing thresholds and room selections are preserved; no migration or device re-pairing is required.

This release is published only through manually dispatched GitHub Actions with **Publish release** explicitly enabled. Python tests, frontend tests, HACS checks and Hassfest must all pass before the workflow creates the GitHub Release and installation ZIP. Live notification/TTS output depends on the configured Home Assistant services.
